$description: Halderworks Instrument, brand house. Generated by tools/export.py to the Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10. A colour or a shadow carries its value in every mode under $extensions.halderworks.modes, and $value is light; a size or duration that a density, the touch floor or reduced motion moves carries those values under $extensions.halderworks.conditions.

bg.$description: the page ground behind every surface

surface.$description: the page a reader works on

fill-hover.$description: a quiet control under the pointer

on-ink.$description: the label on an ink solid

ink-hover.$description: the ink solid under the pointer

accent.$description: a solid: brand button, selected switch

accent-hover.$description: the accent solid under the pointer

on-accent.$description: the label on an accent solid

accent-line.$description: the edge of a selected row or chip

mark-quiet.$description: a quiet highlight behind running text

success-fill.$description: behind a success callout or badge

success-line.$description: the edge of a success callout

warning-fill.$description: behind a warning callout or badge

warning-line.$description: the edge of a warning callout

danger-fill.$description: behind an error callout or badge

danger-line.$description: the edge of an error callout or field

danger-hover.$description: the destructive solid under the pointer

on-danger.$description: the label on a destructive solid

scrim.$description: behind a modal dialog; never read on

chart-1.$description: the first series of a chart with two or more

chart-6.$description: the sixth; a seventh is "Other" or another chart

text-lg.$description: 17: lead, row title in a reading view

control-h-sm.$description: 24: a compact control; never under the 2.5.8 target

control-h-lg.$description: 40: one call to action on a marketing surface

radius-full.$description: avatars and count pills only, where the shape itself carries the meaning

radius-sm.$description: the house register; things inside other things: badges, checkboxes, swatches, the status dot

radius-md.$description: the house register; interactive controls: buttons, inputs, selects, menu items, tabs

radius-lg.$description: the house register; containers: cards, panels, dialogs, popovers, toasts

border-w.$description: every border in the system; there is no 2px border

focus-w.$description: the focus ring: the most used real outline-width in the capture, 246 declarations against 75 at 1px

focus-offset.$description: the gap between a control's own edge and its ring, so the ring reads as a ring

tab-active-w.$description: the rule under the selected tab, the one place a 2px line is a state

icon-sm.$description: inside a badge or beside 12px label text

icon.$description: the default: the most widely used rendered icon size in the capture, 21 of 44 sites

icon-lg.$description: a toolbar or rail icon that carries its own hit target

icon-gap.$description: icon to its own label, under the 4px grid on purpose: 4px reads as one object, 8px as two

bp-sm.$description: phone to small tablet; below it a screen is one column and the rail is a sheet

bp-md.$description: the measured consensus edge: 23 of 44 captured sites declare a 768px min-width

bp-lg.$description: second most declared, on 18 of 44; the rail becomes permanent here

bp-xl.$description: declared on 12 of 44; the content column stops growing and the margins take the rest

bp-2xl.$description: only a wide table or a three-pane shell uses the extra width; prose never does

gutter-sm.$description: page margin below hw-bp-md: 16px on 6 of 12 sites measured at 390px wide

gutter-md.$description: page margin from hw-bp-md to hw-bp-lg

gutter-lg.$description: page margin at hw-bp-lg and above

column-gap.$description: the gutter between grid columns, the fourth most used column-gap in the capture

columns.$description: twelve columns above hw-bp-lg, six from hw-bp-md, four below

container-app.$description: the app shell's cap; past it the content pane stops and the window grows around it

container-page.$description: marketing and documentation: the 1100-1300 band holds 20 of 44 captured sites

container-prose.$description: a reading column on its own: the median measured prose column at 1440px is 721px

measure-prose.$description: long-form: the median running-text width across 30 sites is 64ch

rail.$description: the app shell's navigation rail at hw-bp-lg and above

rail-collapsed.$description: the rail reduced to icons, the only collapsed state it has

panel-w.$description: a menu-bar utility panel: 40ch of 13px text plus hw-cell-pad-x each side

panel-max-h.$description: a menu-bar panel's ceiling: a 32px header, 12 compact rows and a 48px footer

z-sticky.$description: a sticky table head or a pinned toolbar

z-rail.$description: the app shell's rail when it overlays content below hw-bp-lg

z-toast.$description: toasts, which clear a dialog because they report what the dialog did

shadow-dialog.$description: dialogs and sheets, and a menu-bar panel in both themes

display-stretch.$description: the display face's width, as font-stretch: Archivo

read.$description: running prose and quoted words: Literata

mono.$description: code, keys and figures: IBM Plex Mono

textSize.$description: the text-size setting: the root size at the browser's default 16px, set by html[data-text-size]

s.$description: the root at text size S, html[data-text-size="s"]

m.$description: the root at text size M, html[data-text-size="m"]; the default

l.$description: the root at text size L, html[data-text-size="l"]

xl.$description: the root at text size XL, html[data-text-size="xl"]

xxl.$description: the root at text size XXL, html[data-text-size="xxl"]
